Name: Slingshot Bombs
Author: wind0nd
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Slingshot Bombs[/b][/size]
Turn your slingshot into a long-range demolition and fishing tool.[/center]

[b]Slingshot Bombs[/b] adds charge-based bomb firing with configurable projectile speed, explosion radius, monster damage, and map interactions. Aim with your mouse, hold to charge, and send an explosion across the map — or drop one into the water and see what comes flying out.

--------------------

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]

[b]Fire bombs from your slingshot[/b]
[list]
[*]Use Explosive Ammo, Cherry Bombs, Bombs, and Mega Bombs with the mod's projectile and explosion mechanics.[/*]
[*]Hold to charge, aim with your mouse, and release to fire.[/*]
[*]Charging increases projectile speed and applies a higher monster damage multiplier.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Customize your shots[/b]
[list]
[*]Set minimum and full charge times.[/*]
[*]Change the full-charge monster damage multiplier (default 15x).[/*]
[*]Configure each ammunition type's base damage, explosion radius, and projectile speed.[/*]
[*]Choose whether projectiles explode on walls, buildings, or monsters.[/*]
[*]Enable or disable slingshot bomb self-damage.[/*]
[*]Optionally snap your aim to the center of a tile.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Configure map interactions[/b]
[list]
[*]Protect supported facilities and ordinary plants from accidental damage.[/*]
[*]Collect eligible map items as ground drops.[/*]
[*]Enable extra breaking of supported large stone and plant resources.[/*]
[*]Control explosion tilling.[/*]
[*]Optionally apply these map features to placed bombs as well.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Water fishing (new in 1.1.0)[/b]
[list]
[*]Bombs that explode on water now catch fish from that location's seasonal and time-based fish pool.[/*]
[*]Fish are thrown in an arc onto the nearest shore, with a large water splash, droplets, and ripples.[/*]
[*]Configure whether trash can be caught, the base fish count and variance (default 3 +/- 3), and whether fish quality rolls from your fishing level.[/*]
[*]Optionally count the fish toward your collection and grant fishing XP (off by default, since bombs are cheap).[/*]
[/list]
[b]Experience for collected items (new in 1.1.0)[/b]
[list]
[*]Forage collected by a bomb now grants vanilla foraging experience.[/*]
[*]Minerals can optionally grant mining experience.[/*]
[/list]
--------------------

[size=5][b]How to Use[/b][/size]

1. Attach a supported bomb or Explosive Ammo to your slingshot.
2. Hold the tool-use button to charge.
3. Aim with your mouse and release to fire.
4. Adjust settings in Generic Mod Config Menu or config.json.

The default minimum charge time is 0.15 seconds. Releasing before the minimum charge time won't consume ammunition.

--------------------

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, for in-game settings)[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

1. Install SMAPI.
2. Extract Slingshot Bombs into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.
4. Configure the mod in-game with Generic Mod Config Menu, or edit config.json after the first launch.

--------------------

[size=5][b]Compatibility and Notes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Intended for single-player and mouse aiming.[/*]
[*]Placed-bomb map features are disabled by default.[/*]
[*]Water fishing uses each location's fish data, so results respect season, time, and weather.[/*]
[*]Support for custom resources depends on the other mod's implementation.[/*]
[*]Protection and collection depend on how objects are identified; some vanilla or modded objects may behave differently.[/*]
[*]Back up your save before testing map-altering features, especially with mods that add objects or resources.[/*]
[/list]
